name: DongFengYun Hotel Mi'Le - MGallery
positioning: Red-brick art hotel in Dongfengyun Art Village near Mile, Yunnan, among vineyards and lavender fields (officially DongFengYun Hotel Mi'Le - MGallery Collection)
best_for: Travelers drawn to artistic architecture and design
Guests who want a countryside stay with local craft and wine rituals

facts.text: The hotel is in Dongfengyun Art Village, a hamlet of vineyards, lavender fields and post-modern architecture.
The hotel's architecture is artistic and all of its buildings are made of red brick.
The hotel is located in a 4A tourist attraction.
Guests can experience a local welcome ceremony, a wine-opening ritual and pottery-making sessions.
The outdoor pool is surrounded by a 360-degree view of the surrounding scenery.
The fitness center has Life Fitness equipment plus a dry sauna and steam room.
Some Deluxe Rooms come with a private balcony and a garden pool.
The Amber Spiral suite has two units, sleeping up to six, with lake or mountain views.
The Ruby Wheel suite has a living room, lake view and private balcony.
Huijing Chinese Restaurant's Cantonese chef serves authentic Cantonese dishes and modern Yunnan cuisine, with wine pairings for each dish.
The hotel offers wedding planning with indoor and outdoor venues.

considerations.text: Kunming Changshui International Airport is about 150 km from the hotel.
By high-speed train it is a 40-minute ride from Kunming South Railway Station to Mile Station, then a 10-minute taxi to the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the remote location may require extended travel time.
